articleTitle: Intrusion Detection with Uncertainty Based Loss Optimized Multi-Task Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: Among all cybersecurity techniques, intrusion detection systems are the first and effective defense line for network and system. However, to develop an accurate, robust intrusion detection system with decent generalizability, challenges like limited labeled data, balancing between detection rates and false alarms need to be overcome. We propose an effective and efficient approach, in which the multi-class intrusion classification was performed by Multi-task Learning (MTL). A hard parameter sharing MTL model is utilized for the multi-class attack detection, in which uncertainty-based loss optimization is utilized to boost model performance and compute the best weights for each task. Comparisons of the proposed approach with single task learning (STL) models are conducted, and the results validate its balanced performance on different traffic. Moreover, when it comes to the capability to identify rare intrusions with limited samples, MTL model can out-perform other powerful STL models like DNN, CNN, RNN and LSTM.

articleTitle: Designing an Intelligent Information and Analytical System for Evaluating Solutions in Renewable Energy Based on Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The development of the energy industry is conditioned by the main provisions of the national program “Digital Economy of the Russian Federation” and the project “Digital Energy” developed by the Ministry of Energy of Russia. The creation of digital twins is a modern trend in the development of digital technologies. The article considers the problem of designing and developing the concept of an intelligent information and analytical system for evaluating solutions in renewable energy based on digital twins. Such a complex digital solution makes it possible to form an easy-to-use virtual copy of the power system capable of reproducing the structure, condition and behavior of the original with a sufficient degree of reliability to solve the problem of involving RES in the energy balance, taking into account dynamically changing RES technologies, the potential of renewable sources in the region and various groups of criteria for the effectiveness of the system.

articleTitle: Known Adversarial Attacks by 2023
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: AI is one of the most popular field of technologies nowadays. Developers implement these technologies everywhere forgetting sometimes about its robustness to unobvious types of traffic. This omission can be used by attackers, who are always seeking to develop new attacks. So, the growth of AI is highly correlates with the rise of adversarial attacks. Adversarial attacks or adversarial machine learning is a technique when attackers attempt to fool ML systems with deceptive data. They can use inconspicuous, natural-looking perturbations in input data to mislead neural networks without inferring into a model directly and often without the risk to be detected. Adversarial attacks usually are divided into three primary axes - the security violation, poisoning and evasion attacks, which further can be categorized on “targeted”, “untargeted”, “whitebox” and “blackbox” types. This research examines most of the adversarial attacks are known by 2023 relating to all these categories and some others.

articleTitle: Quality in Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The technology and the economy basement have changed dramatically since digital transformation has spread widely. The Total Quality Management approach holds fast but some new features appear in connection to digital instruments, services, processes, products, theirs quality characteristics and assessment methodology. Many of them were invented during the development of the information technology industry in 20th century. Yet some of them are totally new and were created in last years, for example, user experience and user interface technology approach. We plan to publish a new textbook - “Quality in digital economy”. We would like to present its content and discuss its focus points in advance in order to make it more complete and up to date.

articleTitle: Empirical Mode Decomposition Method for Processing Data Monitoring of the Subway Power Supply Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: In this article the scientific problem is raised regarding the insufficiency of processing data monitoring in relation to the subway power supply network. It is proposed to consider the modernization of the monitoring and control subsystem of the power supply network in terms of the Smart Grid concept. The article proposes an empirical mode decomposition (EMD) method for working with diagnostic parameter data monitoring by means of using Python. The authors carried out the dataframe primary processing by current and voltage during the period of 15 calendar days monitoring and obtained the decomposition of the signal into empirical modes. The results showed that the application of the EMD method made it possible to detect the presence of signal components, the content of harmonic components. This makes it possible to study the monitoring data for mutual influences, to identify signal components and to build a system for equipment programmatic search that creates interference.

articleTitle: Quasi-Orthogonal Structured Mersenne Matrices for Masking Digital Video and Audio Data in Distributed Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The paper considers quasi-orthogonal Mersenne matrices structured according to Walsh. The differences between the system of orthogonal Mersenne-Walsh functions and classical Walsh functions are shown. Two- and four-level (modularly two-level) Mersenne-Walsh matrices are considered. Estimates of their use in image compression and masking and protective encoding of digital audio data are given.

articleTitle: Digital Signal and Image Processing Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The use of neural networks for the processing of one- and two-dimensional data is examined in this research. The activating function being crucial to network performance, is frequently disregarded. This function is typically one of the non-adaptive functions. Adaptive sigmoid or ReLU functions are frequently employed but they have drawbacks as they alter the overall outcomes when data from a single, small area is adapted. Using flexible quadratic B-spline functions with free nodes is suggested in this study.

articleTitle: Developing a Strategy for the Digital Transformation of an Educational Organization Based on Cloud Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The article examines the theory and practical implementation of a digital transformation strategy. It was found that the main stages of formation of the digital transformation strategy of the organization are determined by: the use of digital services, individualization of a particular instance of the service, the involvement of the end consumer in the process, customer support throughout the life cycle of the service. Six main stages of implementation of the strategy of digital transformation of the educational process based on the use of cloud technology were formed. Opportunities and threats to the use of cloud technology in the educational space were identified. The experience of using the cloud service “1C: Fresh” in the formation of more than one hundred information bases in the training of specialists in the field of economics and finance was obtained. It was shown that the use of cloud technologies with the provision of students with access to the cloud service of 1C in the educational space of the university simulates the production activities of future specialists in real time. In this case, up-to-date and daily updated for the current legislation programs are used, functionality, cybersecurity and a high degree of data security are maintained at the proper level.

articleTitle: Intelligent Technologies for Designing Information Systems for Controlling the Polymer Waste Processing into Useful Technical Products
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The article describes intelligent technologies used in the design of an information system for controlling the polymer waste processing into useful technical products. The basis of the system is a configurable information model that includes a database of characteristics of polymer waste and a knowledge base of the processes of their recycling into technical products (containers, packing materials, etc.). The knowledge base is built using a production-frame model for the representation of unformalized knowledge about the polymers compatibility, the quantitative ratio of the components of a composite mixture, waste processing methods to obtain a homogeneous mixture with specified properties (strength, resistance to aggressive substance, etc.). The result of the functioning of the system is the formation of a technological map of the production of a technical product, including information about the formulation and synthesis process of the polymer composition, specifications of the hardware design and the values of the technological modes of the production stages. Testing of the system according to the LLC “Plastic processing plant named after “Komsomolskaya Pravda” on the basis of the Polymer Ecology Training Center of SPSIT confirmed its operability and the possibility of use at polymer industry enterprises. The use of the system allows you to reduce the time spent on solving the problem of reconfiguration of production and selection of compositions, reduce defects and improve the consumer characteristics of products.

articleTitle: HRM System Usage in Controlling Quality of Innovation Implementing Process
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: Human Resource Management (HRM) has introduced significant changes over the past several decades when analyzing the essential role of the Human Resource Department (HRD) in an organization. HR systems support organizational structure management, data archiving, strategic staff development planning, commercial organization management, and management of emerging multinational corporations. Therefore, properly implemented HR software helps businesses save time and money. This paper examines the Human Resources system implementation concept, its role within organizations, and considerations for implementing an HR solution.

articleTitle: Increasing the Stability of the Mechanism of Deceleration of Wagon on the Basis of Microprocessor Control Systems on the Railway Sorting Hill
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The paper deals with an important problems of improving the devices for automatic control of a railroad sorting hill yard. A method for controlling the automation of the operation of the wagon lifting retarder mechanism and its development and modernization is proposed. The railway hump yard is illuminated by a control device that automatically slows down and stops the circuit breakers based on their weight through the wagon bouncer mechanism based on the automated microprocessor control system method, by modeling and microprocessor control method, the method of monitoring and controlling the mechanism for decelerating a car on a sorting hill is being improved. A graph of the dependence of the braking time of the wagon on the mass of the wagon is constructed and telemechanics in a state of ensuring the safety of movement of sorting humps at railway sorting hill yards.

articleTitle: An Approach to the Tasks Setting for Synthesizing a Gas Balance Automated Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The gas balance control automated systems in the gas transmission networks is an organizational and technical systems that manage in accordance with the accepted criteria. Tasks of the automated systems of gas balance are the following: gas parameters control during its transportation, costs minimization for maintaining the gas balance, gas leaks and losses prevention. To improve management efficiency, it is advisable to develop new and improve existing management algorithms, use new approaches to setting goals. The article discusses an approach based on the development of a gas transmission network computer model and the implementing in it a system of virtual sensors it, that measure the following gas volumes to eliminate the imbalance, depending on the factors-causes: stock in the main gas pipeline, consumption for own needs and the costs of correcting the imbalance. In the approach, imbalance-eliminating decisions based on the criterion of minimizing the volumes passing through these virtual sensors are considered.

articleTitle: Extending Knowledge Representation System about Planners of Intelligent Information Agents
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The article presents the reasons for the relevance of extending knowledge about action planners of intelligent information agents. The key trends for the necessary extending in the context of the development of the digital economy are highlighted. The concept of forming a system for representing knowledge about action planners of intelligent information agents is proposed. The basic components of the quality profiles of the considered artifacts are described. Classes of models of action planners and methods for their analysis are defined. The formed components of the knowledge representation system about generic action planners of intelligent information agents are considered.

articleTitle: Conceptual Model of an Oil Production Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: In the last decade, the rate of oil production on the shelf has been increasing due to a decrease in oil production onshore for a number of reasons, therefore there is a need to develop management, monitoring systems, etc. to implement more efficient processes on production platforms. A relevant solution is the development and application of intelligent control systems. To do this, it is necessary to develop a conceptual model of the oil production process, having previously studied the offshore production platform as an object of management. In this paper, the conceptual model is developed using the method of expert assessments. The analysis of the consistency of expert opinions was carried out by calculating the Kendall concordance coefficient, sampling the most influential parameters by drawing up a Pareto diagram.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Quality of Soft Computing in a Fog Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of assessing the quality of soft computing on the example of solving the problem of processing video images. The factors influencing the accuracy of event detection based on video information analysis and the most popular algorithms used to determine them are indicated. The problem of comparing the results of experiments in quantitative terms (times, percentages) is indicated, which arises due to the heterogeneity of architectures, algorithms and means of implementing soft computing. A solution method is proposed. A system for evaluating the quality of soft computing has been developed and the effectiveness of its application has been proven on the example of processing video images from cameras installed in the subway. The quality of calculations was evaluated based on the accuracy of event detection and the speed of information processing. It was found that the data processing speed indicators for various soft computing methods differ by ±1.2 times, the accuracy values vary in the range of ±11.7%. The proposed method can be applied in other areas where it is required to evaluate the quality of soft computing, regardless of architectures, algorithms, and development tools.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Aircraft Aviation Equipment Diagnostic System after Flight
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: In this article, analyzing the existing methods of the aviation equipment diagnostic system during post-flight maintenance of the aircraft, it is recommended to use a remote diagnostic system to determine the condition of the aviation equipment during post-flight maintenance. Today, the demand in the aviation industry is increasing day by day and due to the increase in aircraft traffic at the airports, at the same time, the runway traffic management and services have been established quickly and efficiently. Aircraft maintenance takes a lot of time, which in turn causes flight delays. This problem is observed today in the world's largest airports. Such problems affect the quality of service provided by many airlines. Therefore, reducing the time of aircraft maintenance is one of the urgent problems of providing quality service to passengers. A remote diagnostic system for the detection of aviation equipment malfunctions during aircraft maintenance is proposed and its principle scheme is presented.

articleTitle: Research of Clustering Methods of ARM Devices Based for Edge Computing Use Cases
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The work is devoted to the study of clustering methods for ARM devices to organize data processing and computing in a local network for edge computing use cases. The paper presented an analysis of the subject area, containing the study of logical levels of edge computing, the study of container virtualization technologies and clustering methods that could be applied to devices used in edge computing. The study of clustering methods revealed that Kubernetes-based solutions are the most user and developer friendly and provide the greatest number of functional and non-functional features. The best solution according to the given criteria was identified, its advantages and disadvantages were analyzed. The performance of the solution was tested and benchmarked against its public cloud counterparts. The test results showed that the performance of the solution is slightly inferior to their counterparts deployed in cloud providers.

articleTitle: Issues in the Implementation of Secure Software Development Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: This paper presents the results obtained studying the prospective market of software security management systems in Russia that meet the requirements of national standards for secure software development. Basic national standards for secure software development in the context of software products certification are considered. The particulars of national and international standards harmonisation are addressed. Original conceptual models of secure software development are proposed. Statistical data on the introduction of safe procedures in serial production of information protection software is given. The peculiarities of the Russian market of secure software production are pointed out. The conclusion about the effectiveness and prospects of developing software security management systems as part of quality and information security management systems is made.

articleTitle: Application of Visual Management in the Electrical Equipment Plant: Case Study
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The article considers aims and solutions of increasing production effectiveness using visual management. The considered case shows the essence of lean manufacturing in electronical production plant. The article gives the recommendations for visual management implementation and can be applied in the other relevant spheres.

articleTitle: Contemporary Standards in IT Product and Project Development
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The changes made to the project management standard and the seventh edition of the guide to the body of knowledge on project management are considered. The authors compared the changes in the approaches described in the previous edition. Examples of the viability of the traditional approach in project management are given. Conceptual changes in approaches to project management are characterized. The authors, based on the analysis, propose to consider the conceptual changes of the seventh edition as an addition, and not as a replacement for the project management standards of the previous edition.

articleTitle: Design and Quality Assurance of Digital Information Models of the Life Cycle of Catalytic Processes of Secondary Oil Refining
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: An algorithm for designing oil recycling processes is presented, characterized in that it is applicable to various types of oil recycling processes, taking into account modern technologies, which makes it possible to increase design efficiency by implementing the main stages of design - selection and layout of technological equipment and piping, forming a digital information model and design documentation in a single computer environment. The criteria for assessing the quality of the digital information model and the project documentation formed on its basis are given.

articleTitle: Mathematical Models and Data Processing Methods for Improving the Efficiency of High-Tech Production of Polymeric Films
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: Mathematical models and data processing methods used for the digitalization of high-tech production of polymeric films, characterized by flexibility, large-capacity, multi-assortment, returnable waste, have been developed. The models describe the physical processes at the main stages of production (preparation of the extrudate, forming the extrudate, fixing the film structure), take into account the variability of equipment configurations, and make it possible to calculate the quality indices of the extrudate and film that are not monitored in production. Machine learning methods are used to process production data with large volume, high accumulation rate, variety of sources, and predict the quality of films. Mathematical models and methods have been implemented in the form of a software package that is adjusted for various types of films and configurations of production systems. It helps to solve the tasks of controlling the consumer characteristics of films (thickness difference, number of surface defects of various types, shrinkage, color, telescoping). Testing according to the extrusion-calender production of pharmaceutical and food packaging films at factories in Russia and Germany has confirmed the adequacy of the models and the operability of the software package. Their use contributes to improving the production efficiency by increasing the yield of high-quality film with the same amount of raw materials and the possibility of increasing film price for customers due to a significant improvement in the consumer characteristics.

articleTitle: Approaches to the Development of a Software and Hardware Complex to Collect and Process Data from Open Packets of Wi-Fi Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The paper studies a practical implementation of a hardware and software complex for analyzing and collecting data from open packets of Wi-Fi networks (IEEE 802.11 a/b/g/n standard). The main technological limitations of such systems are given and the principal architectures for their creation are proposed, including examples of hardware and software configurations. Examples of operation of such systems and requirements for business applications are given.

articleTitle: Platform (SDK) for Self-Healing of Cloud Services Based on Acquired Cyber Immunity
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Systems Theory and Practice (ISTP)
abstract: The paper describes a platform for self-healing of cloud services based on acquired cyber immunity. This platform is designed to ensure the required level of cyber-resilience of digital platforms by solving various information security problems: certification of computing processes based on the provisions of the theory of similarity and dimensions, identification of correct and incorrect (anomalous) functioning of cloud services, search for patterns of malicious impacts, response to computer attacks, self-learning, self-healing of computations, adaptive cybersecurity management, generation of new cybersecurity knowledge, etc. An evaluation of the effectiveness of anomaly detection by three general groups of methods was carried out.
